payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the image show the background changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: Judge only the requested background change, using both supports and the original image as context. Complete (yes) if the background is visibly a basketball court, supported by a recognizable playing surface and court markings or basketball equipment. Partial if some requested progress is visible but the background is not yet recognizably a basketball court; either support may provide evidence of such progress, but neither alone guarantees it. Absent (no) if there is no visible progress toward a basketball-court background. Unknown if the evidence is insufficient to determine whether any requested progress occurred; required unknown evidence remains unresolved. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Target: The background is visibly a basketball court, with recognizable court features such as a playing surface and court markings or basketball equipment.. Reference: The input image and the requested background change in R1..
